preserve: The existing caller-DATA-selected tree walk and text/table projection, ordered section blocks, format templates, native stdlib DOCX writer and embedded-font ReportLab PDF writer.
The bounded regular-file JSON reader, heading-level/style validation, table boundaries, font-glyph coverage checks and actual saved-byte readback.
The original source and target are the same existing renderer at its real pre-policy snapshot; no archival byte-copy artifact or later reconstructed baseline is substituted.
allowed_deltas: Allow DATA-selected literal whitespace and nesting metadata; preserve native DOCX tabs/newlines and use a readable monospace PDF literal style.
Refuse ragged tables and unsupported literal/indent targets rather than flattening them.
Keep oversized literal lines refused by default; permit explicit caller-DATA soft wrapping with source-hardline character ranges, separate continuation prefixes and selected-boundary refusal.
Offer an optional intended-payload identity through the existing content-identity owner and emit source-bound literal layout provenance for the private consumer.
banned_substitutions: A second file renderer, Markdown parser or identity algorithm.
Clipping, silent truncation, lost indentation/tabs/table cells or unreadable font shrinking.
Using projection or artifact-layout evidence as voice, author or final-delivery approval.

proof.verification_scope: Seven local synthetic source-to-renderer tests and the existing synthetic DOCX/PDF suites passed. Actual private artifacts and whole-book page review are outside this evidence.
